description: This file contains type declarations and function signatures for the Moment.js library, defining how to use Moment objects, functions, and locale configurations in TypeScript projects.

methods.name: declare function moment(inp?: moment.MomentInput, strict?: boolean): moment.Moment; moment
methods.description: Main overloaded function to create Moment objects with various input parameters, supporting local or UTC creation with optional strict parsing and formatting.

methods.name: moment.utc
methods.description: Creates a Moment object in UTC mode, with optional input, format, and strictness.

methods.name: moment.duration
methods.description: Creates a Duration object from various input formats, representing a span of time.

methods.name: moment.locale
methods.description: Gets or sets the current locale for date/time formatting.

methods.name: moment.defineLocale
methods.description: Defines a new locale or overrides an existing one with a specified locale specification.

methods.name: moment.updateLocale
methods.description: Updates an existing locale with new specification options.

methods.name: moment.localeData
methods.description: Returns locale-specific data such as month and weekday names.

methods.name: moment.parseZone
methods.description: Parses an input string into a Moment object with timezone information.

methods.name: moment.isMoment
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a Moment instance.

methods.name: moment.isDate
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a Date.

methods.name: moment.isDuration
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a Duration.

ctags.name: moment
ctags.pattern: /^declare function moment(inp?: moment.MomentInput, strict?: boolean): moment.Moment;$/
